in_sanskrit.name: Chandu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moon God
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Chandu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Originating from the Sanskrit language, the name Chandu is derived from the word Chandrama, which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, Chandrama is the name of the Moon God. Thus, Chandu is a name that honors the divine and celestial energy of the Moon.

in_marathi.name: Chandu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chandu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Originating from the Sanskrit language, the name Chandu is derived from the word Chandrama, which means 'Moon'. In Hindu mythology, Chandrama is the name of the Moon God. Thus, Chandu is a name that honors the divine and celestial energy of the Moon.
